nodes.label: Armored rogue/ranger outfit (cape, pauldron, sword, greaves)
nodes.description: Costume design of the sprite: purple gold-trimmed tunic, dark tattered cape, single black shoulder pauldron, armored boots, belt pouch and a sheathed sword, suggesting an adventurer/rogue class archetype.
nodes.norm_label: armored rogue/ranger outfit (cape, pauldron, sword, greaves)

nodes.label: Dragonborn (Draconiano/Draconiana) fantasy race
nodes.description: Draconic humanoid playable race (D&D-style) offered as one of six races in the avatar roster alongside Elfa, Enana, Gnoma, Humana and Tiflin.

nodes.label: Draconiana Sprite (female dragonborn character portrait)
nodes.description: Full-body 2D character illustration on a white/transparent background: a female dragonborn with purple scales, horned and spiked head crest, glowing violet eyes, cream-ridged throat and tail underside. Wears a fitted purple tunic with gold trim, a dark tattered cape, a single heavy black pauldron, black armored greaves, clawed gauntlets, a leather belt with a pouch, and a sheathed sword at the hip. Used as the selectable avatar preview for the female 'Draconiana' character option.
nodes.rationale: Flat cel-shaded full-body art lets the character-selection UI show each race/gender option at a glance before the matching 3D GLB avatar (glbName 'Draconiana') is loaded.

nodes.label: Enano (Dwarf) Character Class
nodes.rationale: Spanish 'Enano' = dwarf; a fantasy race/archetype the game offers as a playable or NPC character, depicted as a stout melee fighter.

nodes.label: Flat Cartoon 2D Sprite Art Style
nodes.rationale: Hand-drawn style with uniform black outlines and flat fills on transparent PNG, suited for layering over 2D/3D scenes without background cleanup.

nodes.label: Tartan Kilt and Cape Outfit
nodes.rationale: Scottish-highlander-inspired costume (plaid kilt, collared cape, leather bracers, wrapped boots) reinforcing the mountain-dwelling dwarf theme of 'Brillo en la Montana'.

nodes.label: Enano (Dwarf) Male Character Sprite
nodes.rationale: Full-body 2D cartoon illustration (flat colors, black ink outlines, transparent background) of a young male dwarf warrior in an earthy orange/brown palette. Figure is anchored to the bottom of a tall canvas with large empty headroom, suggesting a fixed canvas size shared across character sprites so they align when composited in a character-selection or dialogue UI. Lives under sprites-2d/man/, implying a male variant of a selectable race/class set. Minor artifact: a white unfilled patch on the left shin/boot.

nodes.label: Bottom-anchored Transparent Sprite Canvas
nodes.rationale: The short dwarf figure sits in the lower portion of a tall canvas with empty space above, likely so all character sprites share one canvas size and a common ground line, preserving relative height differences between races.

nodes.label: Hand-drawn Cartoon Outline Art Style
nodes.rationale: Flat colors with dark ink outlines and light linework shading give a readable, consistent illustrated look suited to 2D character selection sprites.

nodes.norm_label: help offer prompt ("¿desea que te ayudemos?")
nodes.rationale: Spanish yes/no question baked into the sprite in which villagers offer the player assistance; text is pre-rendered into the image rather than drawn dynamically.

nodes.label: Parchment Scroll Dialog Panel
nodes.rationale: Aged parchment scroll with rolled wooden ends used as a 2D dialog background, giving NPC text a rustic/medieval mountain-village aesthetic instead of a plain UI box.

nodes.label: Elf Ranger / Archer Character
nodes.rationale: Male elf with pointed ears and a long braided brown hair, wearing a hooded tunic, flowing cloak, belted pouches, bracers and tall boots; fantasy archetype for the male sprite roster.

nodes.label: Elfo Sprite (Male Elf Archer)
nodes.rationale: Full-body 2D character illustration on a transparent/white background, used as a selectable male avatar sprite (sprites-2d/man set). Fantasy elf ranger pose: drawing an arrow from a back quiver while holding a longbow.

nodes.label: Monochrome Blue Flat Line-Art Style
nodes.rationale: Flat-fill, black-outlined cartoon illustration with a limited navy/slate/light-blue palette and skin/brown accents; limited palette suits small PNG sprite assets and a consistent 2D character set.

nodes.label: Gnomo Sprite (2D character art)
nodes.description: Full-body 2D character sprite in flat cel-shaded line-art style. Figure stands bottom-aligned on a tall canvas with large empty headroom above.
nodes.rationale: Bottom-anchored figure on an oversized canvas suggests sprites share a common canvas size and ground baseline so characters line up consistently when rendered.

nodes.label: Scroll Bundle (carried rolled papers)
nodes.description: Rolled parchment scrolls carried on the back and at the hip, suggesting a messenger, scribe or keeper-of-knowledge role.

nodes.label: Crossed-Tools Medallion
nodes.description: Round grey medallion hanging from the belt bearing crossed tool icons (hammer/pick-like), hinting at a craftsman or mining guild emblem.

nodes.label: Gnomo (Gnome / elf-like mountain character)
nodes.description: Young pointy-eared character with dark messy hair and ponytail, wearing layered forest-green vest, sash and baggy trousers over a pale shirt, with dark green boots; one hand on hip, the other raised in a beckoning or explaining gesture.

nodes.label: Gnomo (Woman) 2D Sprite
nodes.description: Full-body, front-facing 2D character illustration on a transparent/white canvas with the figure in the lower portion. A female gnome with pointed ears, wavy auburn hair and green eyes, hands on hips in a confident stance. She wears an olive-green tunic, a draped grey-brown cloak, a leather crossbody strap with brass buckles and a leather satchel, dark maroon breeches, wrapped shins and brown boots. Clean line-art with flat cel shading, an earthy forest palette.

nodes.label: Forest Adventurer Attire
nodes.rationale: Cloak, satchel, leather straps and boots in earthy greens and browns match a mountain/forest theme (project name 'Brillo en la Montana'), giving the character a traveler/explorer identity.

nodes.label: Gnome Character (Female Variant)
nodes.rationale: Selectable fantasy character type for the 'woman' sprite set; placement in sprites-2d/woman suggests characters are organized by gender, with a gnome being one of the available character archetypes.

nodes.label: Univalle Logo (univalle.svg)
nodes.rationale: Static vector emblem served from /public as the institutional brand mark: a red square (#ea1f01) with a white shield-like shape with a rounded bottom, exported from Adobe Illustrator 13. Used across auth and modal screens to identify the app as a Universidad del Valle product.

nodes.label: app (Dev Service, Dockerfile.dev)
nodes.rationale: Bind-mounts the repo into /app (with an anonymous node_modules volume) and sets CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true so file watching works inside the container; runs npm run dev on port 5174 (overridable via DEV_PORT).

nodes.label: app-prod (Production Service, Dockerfile)
nodes.rationale: Optional service behind the 'prod' profile; Vite env vars are passed as build args because they are inlined at build time; exposes 8080->80.

nodes.label: Mobile Viewport Config (no zoom, viewport-fit=cover)
nodes.rationale: Disables user scaling and uses viewport-fit=cover, suggesting an app-like full-screen mobile experience (e.g. iPhone safe areas).

nodes.label: Development Mode with Hot Reload (port 5174)
nodes.rationale: Default mode; live code sync so the browser refreshes on save without rebuilding the container.

nodes.label: Oxlint Configuration (.oxlintrc.json)
nodes.rationale: For production apps, recommends enabling type-aware lint rules via oxlint-tsgolint with react, typescript and oxc plugins (rules-of-hooks error, only-export-components warn).

nodes.label: Production Mode with Nginx (port 8080)
nodes.rationale: Lets developers test the final compiled build served by Nginx.

nodes.label: React + TypeScript + Vite Template
nodes.rationale: Minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.

nodes.label: Despliegue con Docker (Docker Deployment)
nodes.rationale: Project-specific section documenting three ways to run the app: compose dev mode with hot reload, compose prod profile with Nginx, and plain docker build/run.

nodes.label: React Compiler (disabled)
nodes.rationale: Not enabled in the template because of its impact on dev and build performance.
